definitions.population: Every frozen catalog source record, without score, date, document or source filters.
definitions.highest_raw_value: Numeric maximum on each source record's native scale, not a cross-benchmark ranking or necessarily a best result for lower-is-better metrics. All tied observations are retained.
definitions.models: Distinct source model IDs per benchmark among numeric observations; incomplete identities remain unknown. Medians use records with known model counts, not zero-imputed unscored records.
definitions.documents: Distinct cited document IDs; repeated references do not create documents. Missing organizations stay unknown; source labels are not organizations.
definitions.headroom: 100 minus the maximum only for declared percent, higher-is-better records with all numeric values in [0,100]. Ineligibility never removes score values or records.
definitions.dates: Recorded benchmark release dates and per-observation date precision; model announcement dates are not evaluation dates.
